verdict.rationale: Navan has no documented bulk export or account-exit feature. Its API does offer retrieval endpoints across the expense surface (card transactions, manual expenses, payroll, repayments, fees, disputes, receipts), and the MCP server allows querying spend and travel data. Together these allow piecemeal programmatic extraction of expense data, but not a clear 'export everything and leave' path. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, explicit open-format guarantees (CSV/JSON), export coverage for travel/booking and rewards data, offboarding or portability documentation, and independent corroboration.
